[COURSEWORK / PROJECT SUMMARY]{.eyebrow}

## The question

How can audience perceptions be translated into clear survey questions?

## Approach

Coursework and CEP preparation connect constructs, measurement choices, questionnaire wording, and survey logic. Qualtrics supports the draft questionnaire workflow.

## What this work demonstrates

The CEP questionnaire is an unpublished draft pending review, privacy wording, stimulus decisions, and pretesting. No responses or research findings are presented. A planned study should not be described as completed evidence.
